description: Hi everyone! I’m a young space explorer who loves planets, robots, rockets, and space mysteries. For the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, Rover Friends will uncover the stories behind equipment left on the Moon and Mars and discover how these forgotten objects helped scientists explore space. Join us for a fun space adventure!
summary:
Have you ever wondered what happens to machines after they finish exploring space? Are they lost or forgotten? Not at all! They become part of space history!

Hi! I'm an 8-year-old space explorer, and I created Rover Friends to tell the amazing stories of machines and equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars.

Through my YouTube storytelling video, I take you on an exciting journey through space missions. I show how these machines helped astronauts and scientists, why they were left behind, and what they might look like today. I also explore how their discoveries continue to help us learn more about space and plan future missions.

Using pictures, animations, and my own narration, I bring these forgotten space explorers back to life and share their amazing stories with everyone!
details:
My project, ROVER FRIENDS, is about discovering the stories of machines and equipment left behind during space missions on the Moon and Mars.

I created a YouTube storytelling video to show how these machines helped astronauts and scientists explore space, why they were left behind, and what they might look like today.


My video takes viewers on a space adventure using pictures, animations, captions, and my own narration. I explain different space missions and the important discoveries made by these machines.


My project helps people learn about space exploration, NASA missions, and the importance of machines used in space. It also encourages children to become curious about science, technology, and space.


I used a computer, NASA internet resources, NASA pictures, and CapCut to create and edit my storytelling video. I also used my own ideas, research, and narration. No coding or special hardware was used.


I turned space history into an exciting storytelling adventure. Instead of just reading facts, I bring forgotten space machines back to life through pictures, animations, and storytelling.


I focused on NASA mission information, the history of the machines, why they were left behind, their importance, and how to explain everything in a fun and simple way for children.

Machines may be left behind, but their discoveries travel into the future!
